decision: Do not integrate Meshopt into formal runtime/packs in this round. Root accepted this decision after the experiment.
reason: Raw transfer savings are meaningful, but incremental savings over existing gzip/Brotli are small and one Brotli case becomes larger. Avoid extra decoder and approval-audit complexity.
scope: Four already-approved assets only. All outputs and copied dependencies remain under art/full-ai-city/experiments/meshopt. No approved source, formal runtime, packer, or approval registry was changed.

fidelity.bufferViewBytes: Every compressed serialized view was decoded and SHA-256 compared to original bytes; every image bufferView copied byte-identically.
fidelity.structure: All JSON fields other than buffers, bufferViews and compression extension declarations were deep-compared, including accessors, nodes, meshes, materials and animations.
fidelity.browser: The project's existing GLTFLoader loaded original and compressed variants. Geometry attributes, exact index arrays, transforms, selected material/sampler properties and all decoded texture RGBA pixels matched.
fidelity.encoding: ATTRIBUTES/INDICES with filter NONE. No quantization, vertex reorder, index reorder, triangle rotation, simplification or texture recompression.
fidelity.limits: The four approved candidate GLBs contained no embedded animation clips. Do not claim animation playback validation or runtime/scenic performance gains. No whole-region package or actual mobile device was tested.

benchmarkLimitations: Headless desktop Chrome at 390x844 with CPU throttle 1/4/6, GPU disabled and no renderer. CPU slowdown is a proxy, not ARM/iOS/mobile hardware. Decode times include destination allocation; 60 iterations. Three parse trials include texture decode, are noisy and do not establish a loading speed improvement. Local HTTP excludes real download latency. Decoded GPU memory is unchanged.

dependency.proof: vendor/tag-v0.25.json and SHA-256 entries in comparison.json

futureMinimalOption: Only if later delivery measurements justify it: vendor the pinned decoder with MIT notice; set it once on the existing cache's GLTFLoader; compress a validated final pack after approval without altering candidate files; record encoded pack hash plus original pack hash and round-trip evidence. Recheck audit readers and actual target devices. This option was not implemented.
